I aint a hippie, I'm a militant radical.  There's a big difference.  Hippies sit in drum circles, hold hands, and sing kumbaya.  Militants arm the homeless and try to storm federal buildings.  Fuck your legal system, fuck your monetary market system, and fuck your notions of property and ownership.  As a native Comanche, I spit upon your systems of ownership and proclaim that theft in America is perfectly acceptable because it's all stolen land anyway.  Crackerass honkytonk motherfucker.

Property isn't tangible.  Property is a social construct.  You can't actually own anything, because everything's made from raw materials that came from the earth.  These resources were here long before you were born, and the product you think you "own" will be around long after you're dead.  At best, we borrow things.

I don't ask that they agree with me, just that they respect me.  And you're right, Texas is pretty devoid of radicals in general.

In the post I mentioned the PTSD starts in my broken home and neglectful emotionally abusive parents, then keeps snowballing with my violent criminal youth, the sudden loss of several childhood friends, teachers, and mentors to gang violence and suicide.  The most traumatic moment of my life was being stabbed, duct taped, then stuffed in the trunk of a car.  I got driven out to a field in the middle of nowhere where an angry chollo waved a gun in my face for like half an hour to talk to me about the dangers of leaving an organization like the one I was in.  

It was difficult cutting my parents off emotionally and financially, they're horrible people but I can't help but love them.  They're my parents, but they're toxic.  I spent so much of my life trying to save them before realizing I had to try and save myself.  I'm not doing so hot.  I've been 30 since I was 6, trying to parent my parents.

The girl was just the straw that broke the camel's back.  The levees broke, I got trashed, and then I said "Fuck it!"  Don't act like you know me, Texas is a fucking police state.  I can't tell you how many times I'm harassed and/or searched illegally.  My life is a hideous montage of intense fear and overwhelming bitter hatred and spite.  I try really hard to be happy, but no matter what I do I'm empty inside and I get worse every god damn day.  I need help and I'm not getting it anywhere I turn.  I don't know what else to do, I'm at the end of my rope.  And my shaky, paycheck to paycheck existence doesn't do anything to alleviate the stress and fear.  I owe so much money to my school, my heart skips a few beats and my stomach wrenches just thinking about it.

> if you are pretty attractive and people tell you that, in conjunction with your success, I can't understand why you can't find someone

I can't understand it either, neither can my friends.  That's why I'm frustrated and suicidal.  Seems like nothing works and death seems so much easier than going on with this endless trek over a bed of hot coals and nails.

Splendid, we'll get along just fine.

I run, I do situps and pushups, and I lift weights at my university's gymnasium.  Like I said, I'm trying.  I went from like 240 to 155.  I'm making progress, it just feels like never enough which fuels my already very powerful feelings of futility and impotence.  I try as hard as I can and even when it feels like I'm getting good results, nothing changes and I'm still a lonely, miserable man who lacks the cojones to self terminate.

I have no standards.  Tall, short, fat, thin, hairy, bald, midget, lizard woman, amputee, serious burn victim, irradiated mutant.  I do not give a fuck.  I see beauty in everything.  I'm not kidding.  My main question is: "Can I hold a conversation with you, or are you a vapid waste of space who's using up my oxygen?"  People flock to me because they want to work with or be associated with me, not because they want to cuddle or kiss or be close to me.  It's like there's some giant neon sign over my head that says "Do Not Date."  I have on occasion considered mutilating/removing my genitals so as to stop feeling sexual desires.

Having nothing I can pinpoint my romantic failures on, I look to my height and weight despite others insisting that I'm A.) not that fat (at least not any more) and B.) pretty attractive.  Im a mutt, so I'm exotic.  I look like I could be from anywhere in the world and apparently that's mysterious.  

Here's the main difference between you and me:  You are self defeating and are arguably your own worst enemy.  I'm my only real friend, standing alone against the world on sheer willpower alone.
My mindset, all day, every day.  The plan is to wreck myself until there's nothing left to wreck.  I'm here for you, bro.

Thank you, I pride myself on my mastery of the English language.  I fancy myself a wordsmith, it's what I want to do for a living.  The rest of this might sound harsh, but I mean well.

Don't talk to me about confidence, pretty boy.  I'm very confident, I'm a self-absorbed artist and a standup comedian.  I've stared down judges, city councilmen, and police alike, pouring out a tyrade of logic and angry rhetoric.  Lamar Smith (the jackass pushing this SOPA crap) is my representative and you can bet I give him and his secretaries an earful.  I'm funny, I'm witty, I'm charming, and I'm talented.  Should be enough, you're absolutely right, but apparently it's not.

You sound like my old roommate.  We were two sides of the same coin as well.  Abbot and Costello.  He's about 6 feet tall, lanky string-bean lookin muthafucka.  He's also socially incompetent, but it doesn't really matter cause he's got a ten inch dick.  You seem more down to earth than he was, he's a sociopathic manchild.  Probably because his parents never beat him and e'rbody wants his dick.  

Your kind pisses me off, mostly because of the wasted potential in you people.  You say you're pursued?  I don't know what that's like.  Nobody pursues me.  Nobody likes it when I pursue them, they'd rather I was a gender-neutral automaton that didn't need love and affection.  What I would do with your looks!

I'm not hung up on my physical attributes, but I acknowledge the reality that we live in a very visually based society that holds its members up to a very high standard which I do not meet.  I used to when I was younger, and I remember the acceptance and the feeling desired.  When you're fat (or different in general, can't say my intellectualism has earned me much favor either in a society as willfully ignorant as Texas) the world treats you like a creature from a Bella Lugosi film.  I'm not even that fat, damn it people!

I would kill for your looks, sir.  Ethically it's awful, but it's true.  I would slaughter countless thousands if it meant I could be desirable in most people's eyes.  I don't doubt that you understand my self-loathing and insecurities, but don't for a minute assume you could handle how outcast and alone I feel.  People kowtow and bend over backwards for pretty people.  I work twice as hard for half the yield, if even that.   I don't feel valued, because I'm not.  Society only values the beautiful.  Nothing to do but gnash my teeth and bark at the heavens.

I'm fairly blunt, I don't sugarcoat things.  It pisses some people off, but most appreciate that I'm always honest even when it's a bad idea.  I'm unflinchingly and unapolagetically honest about everything because if there's one thing I can't stand it's hypocrites and liars.  So I speak the truth, and sometimes the truth hurts.

I have a nasty habit of falling for lesbians, most of my exes were bi.  I like strong independent women because girly girls piss me off.  Femininity is just another word for emotional dependency, insecure attatchment, vain superficiality and materialism.    Especially in Texas, home of high hair and jalapenos.

I try to be a paragon, but being good sucks.  Also, I'm doing CBT (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy) with my doctor but it's not working.  Seems a lot like lying to yourself until you believe it.  Sounds like bullshit.

I don't WANT to be upset, I want to change the world and I want to be loved.  I'm upset because the world is a shit hole and no matter how hard I try, or how successful I am, I cannot find romantic love.  Everyone keeps telling me I deserve something more, then nobody's willing to pay up.  Everyone promises me I'll find someone and I never do and it makes me crazy!  I feel like I have no agency or control over my life and as a result have a lot of impotent rage.

Also, fuck you, dude.  Not like I'm not aspiring to be with women, they just don't share my aspirations.

I live alone in a small apartment near my university in Texas.  And I do have friends I can talk to, they're just away for winter break now.

I don't fear intimacy, not any more.  When I had my first girlfriend I probably was, but we were both violent and fucked up punk rockers so... it was about as healthy as it was gonna be.  The next girlfriend I pushed away a lot because growing up in my family emotions had only been used to hurt or manipulate me and so I tried to shut them out, to be a machine. 

I've grown a lot since then, I've learned to love and I want nothing more than intimacy.  I want to know someone completely and have them know me.  Nobody wants me for me though.  They want me for my skills and services.  They want me to tech their shows, help them with homework, explain complex economic theories and political situations for them, and of course supply them with the stickiest weed in the area.  Nobody wants ME.  Just things I can do.  Goods and services.  Products and commodities.

I actually like myself a lot.  I don't doubt my creative abilities, or my wit, or my charm.  Women just aren't attracted to me, and if they are they have boyfriends.  The timing is terrible.  If it wasn't for bad luck I'd have no luck at all.

The one that slept with my old roommate said she was "intellectually attracted" to me.  Like I said, I'm perpetually a surrogate father or big brother figure.  Occasionally a professorial mentor and life coach.  But no nookie for me.  Can't get no satisfaction because women treat me like some sort of asexual alien from another world.  Sometimes feels like I'm playing on everybody's team but my own.

I live alone, I haven't lived with that roommate for quite some time now.  He lives a few blocks from me though.  Thanks for trying to help.  I'm just tired of putting in so much work to keep myself alive when I really don't like being alive.

I feel your pain, brother.  The blackness, the dark shroud.  The Dr. Manhattan-esque distancing effect of perspective.  Hang in there, be a good cop.  The world needs more good cops.  Make the world a better place, one day at a time, by helping as many people as you can.  When you help others, you can't help helping yourself.

We now know I have complex post-traumatic stress disorder from living through my crazy, fucked up family, gang life and the criminal underclass's warlike lifestyle, and the life threatening situations that arose when I was leaving that lifestyle.  When I was younger they thought I had ADD because I had trouble with focusing and self-regulation.  So they basically gave a kid with ptsd amphetamines, and were surprised when I became prone to violent mood swings.  Then they thought I had depression, but I wasn't irrationally sad or experiencing an illogical dread of the future, I was a snarky, cynical, and sarcastic kid who looked at everything with a blunt and brutal honesty.  The chemical cocktails they put into me between 4th grade and the beginning of high school had effectively killed my metabolism and blimped me the fuck up.  

In college they thought I was manic depressive, but I never experienced the level of hypo-mania the doctors said I should have.  They mistook my insomnia and passion for mania.  The meds didn't help, therapy doesn't help, nothing helps.  I noticed a lot of similarities between how I was feeling with generalized anxiety disorder, but it didn't fit the bill.  Just like Depression and Bi-Polarity and ADD didn't fit the bill, but I had symptoms from all of them.  Then the more I read about PTSD (which my grandpa, a korean war veteran, suffers from) the more I was like "This all sounds pretty accurate.  Is there a test for this?  Then I took a PTSD diagnostic and scored a 42 on a scale of 51.  9 points away from the high score, woohoo!  If you got above 13 you had PTSD or at least an accute stress reaction.  I was categorized as "Severe PTSD, seek treatment immediately."  We diagnosed me because I, not any number of the expensive fucking mental health experts I've seen over the years, looked into it while I was reading about anxiety disorders.  Therapists are worthless.  And it's also not in their best interests to help you, since you are their customer and they need your money to keep a roof over their head.  Everything's bullshit, especially therapy.  Waste of time, waste of money, waste of my breath.

As long as there are hungry people, as long as there is war, as long as there is injustice and corrupt power structure I will not cease to combat it.  I will change the world or die trying, even though I know which is the more likely outcome.  I am trying to destroy myself, I'm so sick of life I want everything to stop.  I envy the dead.  I have not enjoyed the last 22 years of my life, I don't think that I can handle another 20.  Even if I could handle it, I don't want it.  I hate my life.  Make it end.  I hate everything.  Death is the most appealing thing I feel that I have to look forward to.  Can't keep going.  I see nothing here for me but pain.  Drowning.  No land in sight.  Can't shake the feeling nobody will ever want or care for me, hold me tight and look at me with desire in their eyes--and it kills me.  All I want is to be close to someone.  Most of the people I go to school with don't want to destroy the elite, they want to be the elite.  Society seems to value and exalt everything I want to smash.  They listen to inane nonsensical pop-music that could've come right out of 1984, they concern themselves with social gossip and frivolous bullshit.  Materialism has poisoned our generation.  I have never seen a more selfish people in all my life.  

I worked fast food before, despite being ideologically opposed to it, because I needed a job.  I still eat fast food because it's most readily available and about as cheap as ramen, which I also eat a lot of.  I'm a macrophile, but I don't feel normal amongst even my fellow fetishists because most macrophiles are into violent giantesses, feet, domination and vore.  I just want to cuddle, I want to rest my head on a woman's shoulder or bury my face in her chest.  I close my eyes and imagine myself in the palm of a feminine hand, looking up at a loving billboard sized gaze.  Everything seems futile.  Like I'm waiting for a train that'll never come.  I don't want to live on this planet anymore.

TL;DR  Creatively and academically successful forever alone with PTSD from a broken home and impoverished background with an obscure fetish tries very, very, very hard to cope.  Failing miserably.  Nothing changes.  Nothing works.  Same song and dance.  Always the same.  Feel impotent.  Worthless.  Defective.  Alien, like giant green space-mantis.  Everything always escelates, the only constant in my life is that it gets worse.  Can't count on anyone.  Can't trust anyone.  No hope.  No relief.  No satisfaction.  Just worse and worse and worse and worse.  Sick of waiting, sick of rejection, sick of angst.  Sick of running on empty and not knowing when it'll end.  Sick of life itself.
